name: Emperor Go-Toba
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 99); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 1186–1198; d. 1239.

poems.title: How I regret my fallen friends
poems.author: Emperor Go-Toba
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 99
poems.text:
How I regret my fallen friends
How I despise my foes!
And, tired of life, I only seek
To reach my long day’s close,
And gain at last repose.

poems.title: 99. 人もをし 人もうらめし あぢきなく (Hito mo oshi hito mo urameshi ajikinaku)
poems.author: Emperor Go-Toba
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 続後撰集
poems.text:
人もをし 人もうらめし あぢきなく
世を思ふ故に もの思ふ身は
